open_points.subject: public_op:store.open_store
open_points.text: "Take the exclusive lock, check the data directory and remove temporary files before any record is read."
open_points.question: If the data directory and/or the SQLite file do not yet exist on first start, must open_store create them or refuse start?
options: Create missing directory/database with required private permissions, then continue
Refuse start until directory/database are pre-created by ops
open_points.default_guess: Create missing directory/database and enforce required ownership/permissions before proceeding

open_points.subject: MCP operation read_spooled_file
open_points.text: "read_spooled_file ... names it by its identity ...; its digest, size and media type only describe it"
open_points.question: Does the request include only lookup identity fields, or also digest/size/media_type, and if those descriptive fields are present and mismatch the stored record, is that refused or ignored?
options: Request schema contains only lookup identity fields (run_id, producer_node_id, map_index, attempt_number, producer_port, list_index)
Request schema contains full SpooledFile facts; digest/size/media_type are ignored for lookup
Request schema contains full SpooledFile facts; mismatched digest/size/media_type is refused
open_points.default_guess: Require only lookup identity fields in the request and do not accept descriptive fields as inputs

open_points.subject: public_op:store.read_records (identity mode)
open_points.text: "Inputs: One record type and identities, or one relation..."
open_points.question: Is an empty identity list in identity mode valid, and if not, which failure should be returned?
options: Valid and returns an empty list
Invalid caller defect and returns internal_error
open_points.default_guess: Treat empty identity list as caller defect and return internal_error
